listFormat: UTF-8 source IDs sorted lexically, one per LF-terminated line
rule: Exclude prior IDs. Sort remaining IDs by SHA256 of UTF-8 fresh-2026-11:split:{pid}, ties by lexical ID. First floor(n/10) test, next floor(n/10) validation, rest train. Add prior train/validation to train. Keep prior test in legacy_test, using the original seed:split:{pid} hash rank and floor(0.85*n) cutoff.
